purpose: 独立候选设计，未替换正式图标

images.name: 交错的宽带
images.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a single standalone macOS app icon candidate for ByteTrace, an app-level network traffic statistics app.
Art direction: contemporary, distinctive, lively but controlled, slightly asymmetrical, premium native Mac utility. Avoid dated corporate infographic styling or stiff mechanical geometry.
Composition: square image, one front-facing large macOS superellipse icon tile, centered and occupying about 86% of canvas width. The tile is cool porcelain white with a very subtle icy tint and softly rounded continuous corners. Plain almost-white surrounding canvas, no scene or props. Main sculptural mark occupies 65–72% of the tile; generous but not excessive internal padding. Very shallow 3D relief, crisp silhouette at small icon sizes; no dramatic perspective.
Palette: saturated electric blue #2468F5 as the main identity color, restrained warm orange #FF9855 accent, cool white. Blue dominates the mark; orange is a supporting accent.
Material and light: fine satin molded resin, softly rounded edges, slight translucent edge highlights only, broad soft upper-left studio light, subtle occlusion and a short natural shadow. Carefully shaped volumes; restrained gloss. No chrome, rainbow iridescence, heavy glass, neon glow, texture noise, extreme reflections.
Constraints: one icon only, no comparison grid, no letters or words except a deliberately abstract B when the concept specifically asks for it, no captions, no numbers, no watermark. No screenshot, no chart axes, no gauge, no clocks, no document sheets, no tiny UI details, no literal upload/download arrows. Do not use existing brand logos. Render a finished high-resolution square icon, not a sketch.
Specific concept A — intertwined bidirectional flow: create exactly two chunky, broad, softly twisting sculptural bands, one electric blue dominant band and one shorter warm-orange accent band. They sweep in opposite directions, cross once with a very clear over-under relationship, and form a compact dynamic asymmetric abstract symbol. Wide flat band faces with rounded thickness, not tubular cables, not fabric. The blue part makes a confident rising curve and the orange part a shorter opposing downward curve. Endpoints are blunt and rounded, no arrowheads. Keep open negative space between the forms. Avoid a closed infinity loop, a knot, a chain link, an X, a recycling symbol, a random tangle. One restrained fold per band, a readable continuous silhouette. A modern small sculptural object expressing incoming and outgoing data through motion.

Specific concept B — staggered usage ranking: create exactly three chunky rounded horizontal data blocks of different lengths, arranged as one compact, slightly diagonal and asymmetric cluster. Think of a playful sculptural reduction of application traffic ranking. The longest electric-blue block is central, a medium blue block sits above and a little left, and a short warm-orange block sits below and a little right. The blocks have subtly tapered curved faces and soft rounded ends, a shallow lifting bend, and a little overlapping depth. Their overall rhythm has a gentle 10-degree lift; lengths differ substantially. Keep all three clearly distinguishable. Do not line their left edges up into a conventional chart, do not draw upright bars, do not add chart axes or a baseline. Avoid sliders, buttons, equalizer, corporate dashboard graphics, pills scattered at random. A purposeful unified silhouette with relaxed staggered spacing.
